> Find PRIDE Archive projects by keyword, with every page fetched and no accession repeated: the discovery step that produces the accessions every other pride verb takes.

Wire verb `pride search` · Python [`pymzlib.pride.search`][pymzlib.pride.search]

- [`PrideArchiveClient.SearchProjectsAsync`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveClient.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideArchiveClient.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

- [`PrideYearlyDownloadCount`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideYearlyDownloadCount.cs) in `mzLib/UsefulProteomicsDatabases/PrideYearlyDownloadCount.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | `string` | required | — | `1 to 1000 characters` | What to search for, matched by PRIDE across titles, descriptions, keywords, organisms, references and more. Longer than 1000 characters (mzLib MaxKeywordLength) is a usage error, because PRIDE answers one with HTTP 500, which cannot be told apart from an outage. |
| `page_size` (wire `--page-size`) | `int` | `100` | projects | `>= 1` | Hits requested per underlying API call. Changes how many requests the fetch takes, never what comes back. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | `string` | — | never | The keyword, echoed. |
| `result_count` | `int` | projects | never | Entries in results. 0 is a real answer (no hits), not an error. |
| `results` | `object[]` | — | never | One entry per matching project, deduplicated by accession, in PRIDE's ranking order; fields under result.columns. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accession` | `string` | — | never | The project accession: usually PXD, but also legacy PRD and affinity PAD. Treat it as an opaque key. |
| `title` | `string` | — | never | Project title. |
| `project_description` | `string` | — | never | Submitter's free-text description. |
| `sample_processing_protocol` | `string` | — | never | Free text. |
| `data_processing_protocol` | `string` | — | never | Free text. |
| `doi` | `string` | — | never | Dataset DOI, or "" when PRIDE has minted none. |
| `submission_type` | `string` | — | never | COMPLETE, PARTIAL, AFFINITY or PRIDE (legacy); not a closed set. |
| `sdrf` | `string` | — | never | The project's SDRF term VALUES flattened by the search index into one space-joined string. Not a file, name or URL; "" on most hits. |
| `submission_date` | `string` | — | yes: PRIDE reported no date (mzLib's default DateTime) | Bare calendar date yyyy-MM-dd: no time, no offset, because none was sent. |
| `publication_date` | `string` | — | yes: PRIDE reported no date | As submission_date. |
| `updated_date` | `string` | — | yes: PRIDE reported no date | As submission_date. |
| `project_tags` | `string[]` | — | never | PRIDE's coarse classification tags. Sparse (2.6% of 1,600 sampled hits). |
| `keywords` | `string[]` | — | never | Submitter keywords. May contain empty or whitespace-only strings (about 9% of hits); passed through, not filtered. |
| `submitters` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names, flattened from contact objects. |
| `lab_pis` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names. |
| `affiliations` | `string[]` | — | never | Display strings. |
| `instruments` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names only; the CV accessions are not sent by this endpoint. |
| `softwares` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names. |
| `quantification_methods` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names, e.g. TMT. |
| `sample_attributes` | `string[]` | — | never | Sample characteristic VALUES; which characteristic each describes is not recoverable from a hit. |
| `organisms` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names, e.g. 'Homo sapiens (human)'. |
| `organism_parts` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names. |
| `diseases` | `string[]` | — | never | Display names. |
| `references` | `string[]` | — | never | Each a pre-formatted citation string; no separate PubMed id or DOI. |
| `experiment_types` | `string[]` | — | never | e.g. Data-independent acquisition. |
| `project_file_names` | `string[]` | — | never | File names only: not the manifest (no sizes, categories or locations). Use pride files or pride ftp-files to act on files. |
| `other_omics_links` | `string[]` | — | never | Links to related datasets in other omics repositories. |
| `highlights` | `map<string,string[]>` | — | never | Why the project matched: PRIDE field name -> matched snippets with the terms wrapped in <em>. Keys vary per hit and per query and cross unchanged (not snake_cased). |
| `yearly_downloads` | `object[]` | — | never | {year, count}: year a string (e.g. "2025"), count downloads in that year. Empty when not reported. |
| `download_count` | `int` | downloads | never | Total downloads. 0 means not reported, never a measured zero. |
| `avg_downloads_per_file` | `float` | downloads per file | never | Mean downloads per file. 0 means not reported. |
| `percentile` | `int` | percentile | never | Download-popularity percentile within PRIDE. 0 means not reported. |
| `bot_count` | `int` | downloads | never | Downloads attributed to crawlers. 0 means not reported (populated on under half of hits). |
| `hub_count` | `int` | downloads | never | Downloads attributed to institutional or aggregating hubs. 0 means not reported. |
| `organic_count` | `int` | downloads | never | Downloads attributed to ordinary human traffic. 0 means not reported. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | keyword missing or blank; keyword longer than 1000 characters; page-size not an integer or <= 0 (both checked by the bridge before mzLib) |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | the bridge's own classification (Program.ClassifyError; since mzLib 1.0.593 (#1350) PRIDE raises every transport failure as an HttpRequestException carrying the cause or the status, and messages name the file and host, never the URL): a timeout or cancellation, a socket failure, a request that never got a response (refused connection, DNS, TLS), an HTTP 408, 429 or 5xx, or a body cut off in transit |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | any other HTTP status; a paging contract violation (MzLibException: an identical page while total_records says more remain); the page limit (mzLib MaxPages) exceeded |

### Caveats

- A hit is NOT a project's metadata: PRIDE serves search from an Elasticsearch projection in which every controlled-vocabulary field is flattened to a display string, contacts to names and references to citation strings. Follow the accession for the vocabulary.
- A zero or an empty list means 'not reported', never a measured zero. Several fields are genuinely sparse (sampled over 1,600 hits: project_tags 2.6%, sdrf 2.4%, other_omics_links 18%, the bot/hub/organic trio under half).
- Dates are bare calendar dates, unlike pride files' timestamps with offsets; a binding must not widen them to a midnight timestamp.
- PRIDE pages a live index with no stable cursor: a project published mid-fetch is deduplicated, but one removed mid-fetch can fall between two pages and be missed. A result set that fits on one page cannot be affected.

### Example

```python
hits = pymzlib.pride.search('plasmodium falciparum schizont')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`pride_search_plasmodium.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/pride_search_plasmodium.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.
